verdict.rationale: Persona is an identity-verification SaaS, and AI-generated insights are a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only rule-based workflows, report lookups, and Cases' built-in operational analytics (SLAs, resolution rates). None of these is AI-generated insight or suggestions from the user's data, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
